title: Content Marketing Executive
description:
Salary: Competitive

Hours: Monday- Friday 9am- 5:00pm

At Grundon, we're looking for a creative, commercially minded Content Marketing Executive to join our eight strong Marketing team based in Colnbrook near Heathrow Airport. This is an opportunity for someone who knows how to turn a good idea into content that gets noticed, gets people talking and delivers results.

By joining Grundon, your contributions will make a real difference as we work together to show the world that there is more to waste than it seems.

This is a hands-on role where you'll take ownership from idea through to delivery, working across everything from websites, blogs and email to social media, sales materials, video and thought leadership. You'll be confident working independently, whilst also being comfortable collaborating in a team environment. We want someone who brings ideas, spots opportunities and thinks for themselves - finding new and better ways to engage our audiences and support our customers.

Commercial awareness is equally important. You will understand that great content isn't just about being creative; it needs to have a purpose, connect with the right people and ultimately support our wider business goals.

No two days will be the same. You'll be juggling multiple projects, working with a variety of people across the business and thinking on your feet. You'll also have a keen eye for detail, ensuring our content is consistent, engaging and recognisably Grundon across every channel.

With SEO, AI and the way people discover information changing rapidly, you'll also have the opportunity to help shape how Grundon's content performs in both traditional and AI-powered search.

If you're a confident content marketer who combines creativity with commercial thinking, enjoys getting stuck in and wants the freedom to bring your own ideas to the table, we'd love to hear from you.
- Benefits
- Pension Scheme
- Life Assurance
- Employee Assistance Programme
- Health Cash Plan
- Discounted Gym Membership
- Cycle to Work Scheme
- Mobile Phone Discounts
- 30 day's annual leave (inclusive of bank holiday)
- Holiday Purchase Scheme
- Refer a Friend Scheme

What will you do
- Own and deliver multi-channel content across websites, blogs, guides, social media, email, newsletters, sales literature, video, and other formats, tailoring content to different audiences and aligning it with Grundon's brand and commercial objectives.
- Lead and develop our content strategy and editorial calendar, managing multiple projects from initial brief and idea generation through to delivery, ensuring content supports wider Marketing and business priorities.
- Create thought leadership and industry content by researching market trends, industry developments, and customer needs, turning complex information into engaging and accessible content that positions Grundon as a trusted industry expert.
- Drive SEO and AI discovery, working closely with the Digital Marketing Executive to optimise content for search engines and AI-powered search and answer platforms. You'll also use AI tools intelligently to research, test, and refine content.
- Support our Commercial team by creating customer-focused content and marketing materials that help generate new business, retain customers, and strengthen relationships. You'll also provide ad-hoc marketing support at customer events.
- Build relationships with subject matter experts across the business, drawing on their knowledge and expertise to develop accurate, relevant, and credible content.
- Collaborate with Design and Multimedia teams to bring content to life through engaging visual and multimedia formats, including video, animation, and infographics

About you
- Minimum of two years of experience in content marketing, campaign management, copywriting, or a related role.
- Proven experience in content creation, strategy, and multi-channel marketing; experience with scriptwriting and video/animation concept development is a plus.
- Exceptional writing and editing skills, with a strong understanding of tone of voice and brand consistency.
- Ability to tailor content effectively to different audiences and channels.
- Knowledge of SEO/AEO best practices, audience segmentation, and engagement strategies.
- Strong project management, organisational, and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook, and PowerPoint); familiarity with digital marketing tools such as WordPress is desirable.
- Self-motivated and proactive, with the ability to work independently, make informed decisions, and take ownership.
- Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, with a strong focus on the end-user experience.
- Knowledge of, or interest in, the waste management and aggregates sectors is advantageous.

About Grundon

Grundon is the UK's largest family-owned supplier of integrated waste management and environmental services. We offer a whole host of waste collection, treatment and disposal services, all aimed at helping businesses of all shapes and sizes reduce their environmental impact, maximise resources and find value in their waste. Additionally, at Grundon Sand & Gravel we proudly produce and source high-quality aggregates in a responsible and sustainable way.

We take great pride in our heritage and our distinctive approach, which is true to our company values which include:
- To have integrity
- To be caring
- To deliver excellence
- To maintain curiosity

At Grundon, we are dedicated to creating a diverse, equal, and inclusive workplace. We believe great ideas come from everywhere, and we're committed to creating an environment where everyone feels valued, heard, and empowered to thrive.

If you're ready to take the next step in your career within waste management, this is your opportunity to join us.

title: Internal Communications & Marketing Executive
description:
Hours: Monday- Friday 9:00am-5:00pm

Salary: Competitive

Are you looking for an exciting opportunity where your skills will shine and your ideas will shape the future?

At Grundon, we are on the lookout for a dynamic, passionate, and driven Internal Communications & Marketing Executive to join our Marketing team based in Colnbrook.

This is more than just a job, it's an opportunity to join a company that is here to show the world that there is more to waste than it seems. Here your contributions will make a real difference as we work towards our shared vision to unlock the potential of waste whilst we are dedicated to leaving a better planet for future generations.

Reporting into the Marketing Manager, you will play a key role keeping our employees informed, engaged and connected. This is a hands-on role where you'll help deliver clear, timely and meaningful communications across the business - from producing weekly emails and managing various internal communication channels to advising senior leaders on colleague announcements, sharing business updates and leading internal campaigns.

What will you do
- Support the development and delivery of an effective internal communications strategy, continuously seeking ways to improve and ensure it remains relevant and engaging for colleagues.
- Support the maintenance of our online platform GrunHub, working closely with its developer, to assist with communications across digital and physical channels including emails, screens, posters, JotForms and colleague materials, ensuring content is consistent, on-brand and aligned with our tone of voice.
- Create and share engaging content that informs and connects colleagues, including articles, photography, video, internal emails and push notifications.
- Work with Graphic Designers to develop visual assets across a range of communication channels.
- Use analytics, employee feedback, surveys and on-site engagement to understand what resonates with our people and identify opportunities to improve communication and engagement.
- Produce regular monthly reports on internal communications performance, sharing insights and recommendations for future focus and improvement.
- Support Sales and Client Engagement teams with marketing activities, including customer events such as Waste Awareness Days, to strengthen relationships and support business growth.
- Monitor and maintain stocks of promotional materials and sales literature, ensuring teams have the resources they need when they need them.

Why you will like working here:
- A supportive, inclusive, and fun team culture.
- Designed to empower you to work where and how you thrive, balancing productivity with lifestyle.
- Opportunities for career growth and development.
- Competitive salary and great benefits.
- A company that values your voice and ideas.

About You
- Degree in Marketing or a related subject such as PR, Communications, Creative Writing or Media Studies (BA, BSc or equivalent),
- 1-2 years' experience in internal communications, PR, or a marketing/communications-related role.
- GCSE English at Grade C/3 or above, with A Level English desirable.
- Full, valid UK driving licence.

About Grundon?

Grundon is the UK's largest family-owned supplier of integrated waste management and environmental services. Founded in 1929, we have developed a distinctive approach that has helped us to maintain a leading position within the waste industry. This approach is underpinned by our commitment to quality of service, innovation and technical progress, together with a genuine and demonstrable concern for the environment.

Why Grundon?

At Grundon, we are dedicated to providing diversity, equality, and inclusion. We believe great ideas come from everywhere, and we're committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels valued, heard, and empowered to thrive.

If you're ready to take the next step in your career within the dynamic world of waste management and environmental services, this is your opportunity to join one of the industry's most respected names.

description:

title: Marketing Officer
description:
Marketing Officer

We have a fantastic new job opportunity for a self-motivated and purpose-driven individual with experience of direct marketing campaigns, campaign analysis, copywriting, supplier management and supporter engagement.

If you've also worked in the following roles, we'd also like to hear from you: Fundraising Officer, Marketing Executive, Campaign Officer, Direct Marketing Officer, Fundraising Campaign Officer, Campaign Executive, Supporter Care Officer, Community Fundraiser, Marketing Campaign Executive, Fundraising Executive, Direct Marketing Executive, Fundraising Administrator

The official title for this role is Single Gifts Campaign Officer (Marketing Officer)

SALARY: £31,000 - £34,000 per annum + Excellent Benefits

LOCATION: Reading, Berkshire / Hybrid working with a minimum of 2 days per week in the office, including Thursday team days

JOB TYPE: Full-Time, 12 Month Fixed Term Contract

WORKING HOURS: 35 Hours per Week, 9am - 5pm, Monday to Friday

JOB OVERVIEW

This is an exciting opportunity to join the company as a Marketing Officer, delivering engaging direct marketing campaigns that inspire supporters to take action and help maximise income across cash appeals, raffles and mid-value giving programmes.

Working as the Marketing Officer, you will manage multi-channel campaigns from planning through to delivery, ensuring activity is completed on time, within budget and achieves strong results.

As the Marketing Officer, you will use your campaign management, copywriting, analysis and stakeholder management skills to support supporter engagement, campaign performance and continuous improvement.

DUTIES

Your duties as the Marketing Officer include:
- Campaign Delivery: Manage acquisition and retention campaigns from planning through to delivery, ensuring activity is completed on time, within budget and focused on maximising response and value
- Campaign Briefing: Write clear briefs for creative, data, response handling and supporter care activity, ensuring approval processes are followed and stakeholders are kept informed
- Project Management: Manage non-campaign specific projects when required, including stewardship and retention activity, ensuring delivery to agreed timescales and budgets
- Campaign Planning: Input into the strategic direction of single gifts activity and make recommendations to improve schemes, processes and future campaign performance
- Analysis and Reporting: Conduct regular campaign analysis, produce post-campaign wrap-up reports and make practical recommendations for improvement
- Supplier Management: Manage external suppliers to ensure quality work is delivered within agreed schedules and at a competitive cost
- Digital Coordination: Work with digital colleagues to ensure product-specific content is kept up to date and digital activity is considered across campaigns and projects
- Budget Management: Manage individual project and campaign budgets, follow financial processes and provide accurate income and expenditure information to support planning and forecasting
- Team Support: Line manage and work alongside a Campaign Executive on selected projects, supporting their professional development

CANDIDATE REQUIREMENTS

ESSENTIAL
- Degree or equivalent qualification
- Demonstrable experience in a direct marketing environment, delivering varied projects across multiple channels simultaneously
- Experience managing project spend and working with different internal teams
- Experience working with external suppliers
- Proven understanding of direct marketing principles and techniques, including briefing and interpreting analysis
- Some knowledge of print and production
- Up to date knowledge of PCI, the Data Protection Act, the Gambling Act 2005, Charity Commission guidance and Institute of Fundraising Good Practice
- Proven organisational skills with the ability to manage several projects at the same time
- Excellent interpersonal and communication skills
- Literacy, numeracy and Microsoft Office skills, including Word, Excel and PowerPoint
- Creative and analytical skills
- Comfortable working in environments where dogs may be present
- Eligibility to work in the UK

DESIRABLE
- Diploma in Fundraising and/or Marketing, or equivalent experience
- Experience working in the charity sector

BENEFITS
- Generous annual leave: 26 days rising to 28 days after three years, plus bank holidays
- Employee Assistance Programme

- Menopause Champions

- Eye care vouchers for free tests and VDU glasses contributions

- Discounts and cashback across retail, supermarkets, travel and more
- Pension scheme
- Life assurance at four times salary
- Flexible benefits allowance (equal to a proportion of your annual salary) and the option to buy or sell annual leave

The Charity is committed to safeguarding and promoting the welfare of all children, young people and vulnerable adults with whom they work. They expect all of their employees and volunteers to fully share this commitment.
